repo_shape.summary: Two mostly-independent halves being wired together: a static HTML/CSS/Tailwind frontend prototype, and a FastAPI backend that is the source of truth for business logic.
repo_shape.top_level_entry_point: index.html — meta-refresh redirect into Ui_Prototype_MVP_Prep/index.html (the marketplace landing page).

directories.backend/: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + Alembic REST API. Source of truth for business logic. IMPORTANT: this entire directory is untracked in git as of 2026-08-01 (see git_state.backend_untracked below) — it exists only in the working tree, not in any commit.

directories.backend/docs/: Hand-written docs: ARCHITECTURE.md, API.md, DEPLOYMENT.md, OPERATIONS.md, FRONTEND.md, TESTING.md — treat these as authoritative and read them directly for full prose detail.

frontend.conventions: Each prototype page has a matching hand-authored CSS file (css/<page>.css) and Tailwind config (js/tailwind.config.<page>.js) — one pair per page, not shared. Check for an existing pair before adding styles for a page. stack.migrations: Alembic 1.18.4 — schema is NEVER created via Base.metadata.create_all(); alembic upgrade head is the only path.
stack.db_driver: psycopg[binary] 3.3.3 (Postgres) — SQLite (sqlite:///./adspace.db) supported for local dev/tests.
stack.email: smtplib via a thin send_email() adapter — not yet invoked by any worker.
stack.testing: pytest 9.1.1 + pytest-cov; fully mocked/local-only, no external services required to run the suite.

setup: # set DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./adspace.db in .env for local SQLite instead of Postgres
run_commands.serve: uvicorn app.main:app --reload  # interactive docs at /docs (disabled when APP_ENV=production)
run_commands.docker: docker compose up --build -d   # from backend/; runs alembic upgrade head then uvicorn; requires APP_ENV=production, real DATABASE_URL, 32+ char SECRET_KEY, restrictive CORS_ORIGINS/ALLOWED_HOSTS

modules.app/main.py: All routes, authorization checks, pricing math, workflow orchestration, security middleware. No service/repository layer — everything is flat.
modules.app/models.py: SQLAlchemy entities and status enums (Role, ListingStatus, BookingStatus, PaymentStatus, JobStatus).
modules.app/config.py: pydantic-settings Settings, env-backed, loaded from backend/.env.
modules.app/integrations.py: validate_gstin, geocode, send_email, store_file, invoice_pdf — thin adapters, each fails safe / falls back to local behavior when unconfigured.
modules.alembic/versions/9e6fb23d291b_initial_pr: The single migration so far; creates all 8 tables listed under entities below.

settings_env_vars.app_env: development|production. production disables /docs and disables the simulated payment-confirm endpoint.
settings_env_vars.database_url: default sqlite:///./adspace.db; use postgresql+psycopg://... in production.
settings_env_vars.secret_key: JWT signing secret; must be unique 32+ chars in production.
settings_env_vars.allowed_hosts: comma-separated TrustedHostMiddleware allowlist (only enforced when app_env=production).
settings_env_vars.smtp_host/smtp_port/smtp_username/smtp_p: optional; send_email() no-ops if smtp_host unset.
settings_env_vars.s3_bucket/s3_region: optional; store_file() falls back to local uploads/ if s3_bucket unset.
settings_env_vars.google_maps_api_key: optional; geocode() returns (None, None) if unset.
settings_env_vars.gst_validation_url/gst_validation_api_ke: optional; validate_gstin() falls back to a length>=15 check if unset.

roles.advertiser: Browse active listings, create bookings, create VAS orders, create payment intents, view invoices and advertiser dashboard.
roles.owner: Submit listings and documents, pause/resume approved listings, view owner dashboard.
roles.admin: Review pending listings, manage VAS job assignment/status. Production blocks public self-registration as admin — provision via internal process/migration.

entities.User: users — email(unique), full_name, password_hash, role, gstin?, kyc_status.
entities.Listing: listings — owner_id→users, title, space_type, description, location, latitude?, longitude?, width_ft, height_ft, price_per_day, footfall_estimate?, status, rejection_reason?. Lifecycle: pending_approval → active/rejected; active ⇄ paused.
entities.ListingDocument: listing_documents — listing_id→listings, uploaded_by→users, original_name, content_type, storage_key(unique). Ownership/GST evidence file.
entities.Booking: bookings — listing_id→listings, advertiser_id→users, start_date, end_date, base_amount, vas_amount, vas_services(JSON)?, gst_amount, total_amount, status. Lifecycle: pending_payment → booked → active, or cancelled.
entities.VASOrder: vas_orders — advertiser_id→users, booking_id→bookings?, own_space_details(JSON)?, services(JSON), subtotal, gst_amount, total_amount, status, assigned_to→users?, scheduled_date?. Lifecycle: unassigned → scheduled → in_progress → completed, or cancelled. Linked to a booking OR standalone (advertiser's own space).
entities.Payment: payments — booking_id?→bookings, vas_order_id?→vas_orders, amount, status, provider_order_id(unique). Lifecycle: created → paid/failed. Provider-neutral intent record; no real gateway yet.
entities.Invoice: invoices — invoice_number(unique, format ADS-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXXXX), booking_id?, vas_order_id?, user_id→users, amount, gst_amount, document_key? (PDF storage key).
entities.Notification: notifications — user_id→users, event_type, message, read(bool). In-app outbox only; no SMTP/SMS dispatch worker exists yet.
entities.AuditLog: audit_logs — actor_id?→users, action, entity_type, entity_id, details(JSON)?, created_at. Written on every sensitive business mutation.

pricing.money_type_caveat: Stored as Float in the MVP schema — NOT safe for real financial settlement yet; migrate to Decimal/integer-paise before real money moves (see known_gaps).

api.auth_scheme: Authorization: Bearer <JWT access_token> from /auth/login; payload = {sub: user_id, role, exp}, HS256.

endpoints.purpose: Liveness; also verifies security headers in tests.
Create advertiser/owner account (admin allowed only outside production).
Active listings; filters location, space_type, max_price.
Create listing (status=pending_approval); geocodes location if lat/lng omitted and Maps key configured.
Owner's own inventory including non-public states.
Multipart upload (field 'file'); PDF/JPEG/PNG/WebP only, max 10 MB.
{approve:true} or {approve:false, rejection_reason} (reason required on reject); notifies owner.
Create booking; 404 if listing not active; 409 on overlapping non-cancelled dates; computes base/vas/gst/total.
Create VAS order; booking-linked reorder requires booking.status==active, else own_space_details required.
Create payment intent for a booking (own only).
Create payment intent for a VAS order (own only).

DEV-ONLY simulated outcome (501 in production). On success: marks booking booked, issues invoice, creates linked VASOrder if vas_services present, sends notifications. On VAS-order payment success: issues invoice, notifies.

typical_booking_workflow: Owner registers, submits listing, uploads documents.
Admin approves listing; it becomes discoverable.
Advertiser browses and creates a booking with optional VAS items.
API creates a payment intent; dev-only confirm marks it paid, confirms booking, creates invoice, records notifications.
Admin assigns/advances the related VAS job(s).

security: JWT (HS256) contains user id, role, expiry.
Role guards (require_roles) enforced in main.py, not at the DB level.
Login/registration are IP rate-limited via slowapi (10/min, 5/min respectively).
CORS via CORSMiddleware (settings.cors_origins) and TrustedHostMiddleware (enforced only when app_env=production).
Every response gets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin.
Upload validation: MIME allowlist + 10 MB size cap.
audit_logs row written on registration, login, listing create/status-change/review, booking create, VAS order create/update.
Production blocks public admin registration and the payment-simulation confirm endpoint (501).

tests.isolation: conftest.py creates a fresh shared in-memory SQLite DB per test and overrides the get_db dependency; writes invoice artifacts to pytest's tmp dir. Never touches adspace.db, Postgres, S3, Maps, GST, or a real payment gateway.

files.test_design_workflows.py: Acceptance suite derived directly from the arch/ activity diagrams — owner submission→approval visibility, rejection requires a reason + notifies owner, booking pricing/GST/date-overlap rejection, booking+VAS single paid lifecycle creating one linked VASOrder, VAS standalone vs. reorder-requires-active-booking rule, admin-only VAS queue actions, advertiser denied admin actions.

tests.known_gap_found_by_tests: First implementation only priced VAS into the booking total; the design test exposed that checkout-time VAS must also produce an operational VASOrder job once payment succeeds — now fixed (see confirm_payment in main.py).

known_gaps_before_public_launch: No real payment gateway/webhook — implement provider checkout + signed, idempotent webhook; never trust a client-supplied 'paid' value.
Money stored as Float — move to Decimal/integer-paise before handling real settlement.
Notifications are DB rows only — no worker actually sends email/SMS yet; add a durable queue + retry/dead-letter.
No DB-level booking concurrency locks — current overlap check is a query, not a constraint/transaction lock; race possible under concurrency.
Uploaded documents/invoices need authorization checks + short-lived signed URLs when served, not just storage.
No observability yet: structured logs, error tracking, metrics, uptime probes, DB backups.
No dependency/security scanning or integration/load tests wired into CI yet.

external_integration_status.postgres: Supported via SQLAlchemy + docker-compose; use managed PG + TLS + backups in production.
external_integration_status.file_storage: S3 when S3_BUCKET set, else local uploads/; needs private bucket + IAM + signed URLs in production.
external_integration_status.gst_validation: Calls configured URL if set, else a basic length>=15 check only.
external_integration_status.google_maps: Geocodes listing location only if GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY set.
external_integration_status.smtp: send_email() adapter exists; nothing currently calls it in a background worker.
external_integration_status.payments: Intent-only; simulated confirm is development-only and 501s in production.
